extracted.name: Spicy tuna wrap
extracted.description: Rustle up a spicy tuna wrap for a flavour-packed lunch, ideal to pack in a lunchbox for work or school. Spring onions, gherkins and capers all go well in it too, if you want to use up what’s in the fridge
ingredient_lines: 30g jalapeños finely chopped, plus 2 tbsp of the brine
instruction_lines: For the filling, put the tuna, mayo, red onion, jalapeños (along with the brine), dill, cucumber and Tabasco in a large bowl. Season and mix well. Will keep chilled for three days.
Layer half of the filling into each wrap and top with the lettuce. Wrap with baking parchment and pack into a lunchbox. Keep in the fridge or in a cool bag until ready to eat.
